Gabriel Mozes is an orthopaedic surgeon known in Israel and beyond, and head of the shoulder surgery department at the Ichilov clinic. Patients from around the world seek an appointment with him, because in most cases the results of his operations allow full rehabilitation and a return to normal life without limitation or pain.

Dr Mozes uses advanced methods in his practice and constantly builds on the knowledge he has acquired. To reach this level of expertise he trained and undertook fellowships at leading orthopaedic clinics around the world and took part in international medical research. Throughout his career Dr Mozes has continuously developed his skills, mastering new specialisations and methods that allow better results in the treatment of orthopaedic and neurological conditions.

The doctor's main specialisations:

  • Orthopaedic surgery
  • Shoulder surgery
  • Vertebroplasty
  • Joint transplantation
  • Joint replacement
  • Auditory nerve neuritis
  • Hearing loss

Education and fellowships:

  • Graduated from the Iuliu Hatieganu University of Medicine and Pharmacy, Cluj-Napoca, Romania.
  • Graduate of the fellowship programme in shoulder and spinal surgery at the Royal National Orthopaedic Hospital, Stanmore, London, United Kingdom (1989-1990).
  • Practice in orthopaedic surgery at the Soroka centre, Beersheba (1984-1989).
  • Specialisation in orthopaedic surgery at the Soroka centre, Beersheba (1977-1984).

Academic and research work:

  • Author of more than 50 research papers.
  • Teacher at Tel Aviv University and at the university in Beersheba, Israel.

Membership of professional organisations:

  • American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons
  • International Society of Arthroscopy, Knee Surgery and Orthopaedic Sports Medicine
  • Society of orthopaedic sports medicine
  • Israel Orthopaedic Association
  • Israel Shoulder and Elbow Society

More on the conditions the doctor treats:

  • Auditory nerve neuritis
  • Hearing loss
  • Vertebroplasty
  • Joint transplantation
  • Joint replacement

Languages:

  • English
  • Hebrew
  • Russian (simultaneous interpretation)

Professor Gabriel Zeilig
Specialisation: rehabilitation, physical medicine, anaesthesia, intensive care, trauma

Main areas of specialisation:

He is a leading specialist in rehabilitation and physical medicine and heads the neurorehabilitation hospital of the Sheba Medical Centre at Tel HaShomer. His professional interests include the rehabilitation of patients with injuries of the spinal cord and brain and the treatment of movement disorders and chronic pain.

Education:

  • 1983: Graduated from the faculty of medicine, University of Milan.
  • Fellowship: Sheba Medical Centre, Tel HaShomer.
  • Doctoral degree: rehabilitation after neurological trauma, University of Maryland, USA.

Clinical and academic experience:

  • Professor in the department of neurology: Sackler Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University.
  • Lecturer: School of Nursing, School of Physiotherapy and the Sackler Faculty of Medicine, Israel.
  • Author of the «Steps» method: a unique approach to the rehabilitation of patients with spinal injury, used in the rehabilitation of wounded American and Israeli soldiers and of leading athletes.
  • Attending physician: centre for the rest and rehabilitation of veteran athletes in Tel Aviv.
  • Participant in international conferences and symposia: takes part regularly in the world's leading events on neurorehabilitation.

Membership of associations:

  • Scientific secretary of the European Federation of NeuroRehabilitation Societies.

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Professor Gabriel Zeilig is known for his advanced methods in rehabilitation and physical medicine, thanks to which many patients have been able to return to a full life after serious injury and illness. His contribution to research and clinical practice is recognised internationally.

Professor Gadi Keren is an outstanding cardiologist with more than 35 years of experience behind him. His professional skills and knowledge make him one of the world's leading specialists in cardiology.

Professor Keren is not only an excellent doctor but also an innovator who applies the latest advances of science in his practice. Among the methods he commands are:

  • Cardiac catheterisation: an invasive investigation that makes it possible to diagnose and treat various heart conditions. It involves passing a thin plastic catheter into the heart through a vein or artery.
  • Fitting a cardiac patch: used in the treatment of arrhythmia, this device helps to control and stabilise the heart rhythm.
  • Dissolvable stents: a modern device that helps prevent the narrowing of arteries.
  • Implantation of an artificial valve: for patients with a defect of the heart valves.
  • Introduction of stem cells into the heart muscle: an advanced technology used to repair and treat damaged areas of the heart muscle.

Professor Keren's diagnostic skills also deserve particular mention. He is a master of echocardiography, the ultrasound technique that produces a real-time image of the heart and allows its size, shape, position, structure and function to be assessed. The professor also studied methods of non-invasive imaging of the coronary arteries in the United States, which makes him one of the few specialists able to carry out this investigation at the highest level.

Professor Keren is known not only for his high level of skill but also for his remarkable ability to detect cardiovascular disease at the earliest stages. His diagnostic accuracy and unmatched experience make him a true authority in his field.

EDUCATION

  • Tel Aviv University — graduated from the faculty of medicine and took a doctoral degree in medical sciences
  • Ichilov Medical Centre — specialised in cardiology
  • Albert Einstein College of Medicine (New York, USA) — fellowship in echocardiography, haemodynamics and the treatment of heart failure
  • Washington Hospital Center (USA) — specialisation in non-invasive imaging of the coronary vessels

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ORGANISATIONS

  • Israel Heart Society
  • European Society of Cardiology
  • American Heart Association
  • American Society of Echocardiography

Dr Guy Morag holds a leading place among Israeli specialists in sports medicine and orthopaedic surgery. His active involvement in research includes the surgical treatment of various injuries, sports injuries among them. Dr Morag's research covers not only his time as an orthopaedic surgeon at the Ichilov complex but also his fellowships abroad. He has published a number of papers in specialist journals on surgical orthopaedics and arthroscopy.

Main areas of specialisation

  • Sports injury.
  • Arthroplasty (joint replacement).
  • Replacement of hard tissue after the removal of tumours.
  • Surgical treatment of joints and bones.
  • Surgical treatment of herniated discs.
  • Surgical treatment of congenital abnormalities of the musculoskeletal system.
  • Orthopaedic surgery of the ankle, knee and hip joints.

Education and clinical experience

  • Dr Morag graduated from the faculty of medicine at the Karl-Franzens University in Graz, Austria.
  • Specialisation in orthopaedic surgery in the Sackler department at Tel Aviv University.
  • Fellowship in orthopaedic surgery using endoscopic methods at the University of Toronto.

Positions

  • Senior physician, orthopaedic surgery department, Ichilov complex.
  • Senior physician, sports medicine department, Ichilov complex.
  • Leading surgeon of the orthopaedic surgery department.
  • Chief physician of the Hapoel Petah Tikva football club.
  • Physician to the Maccabi basketball club.

Academic and research work

  • Teaches in the orthopaedics department of the Tel Aviv medical centre.
  • Instructor in the postgraduate education department, Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University.
  • Author of 7 publications in research and clinical fields.

Membership of professional organisations

  • Active member of numerous professional societies in Europe, America and Asia in orthopaedic surgery and sports medicine.
  • Member of the International Society of Arthroscopy, Knee Surgery and Orthopaedic Sports Medicine (ISAKOS).

Dr Galina Shenkerman is one of the most authoritative figures in medicine, particularly in endocrinology. Her standing is confirmed by more than 40 years of clinical practice, and she is deservedly recognised in the international medical community as an expert in thyroid disease, diabetes and obesity.

Dr Shenkerman's professional path has been rich and varied. For many years she headed an outpatient department specialising in the treatment of obesity. Her innovative methods and approaches to this difficult problem have helped many patients return to a healthy life, leaving excess weight and its attendant illnesses behind.

As a senior physician in the endocrinology department, Dr Shenkerman has made a great contribution to developing and introducing the newest techniques and therapies for the effective treatment of endocrine disorders. Her professional experience and deep knowledge have formed the basis for many studies and publications.

It should also be noted that Dr Shenkerman is a consultant to Maccabi, one of Israel's largest health insurers. In this role she works closely with other specialists, exchanging experience and recommendations to ensure the best level of medical care for all the company's members. This position confirms her outstanding contribution to the development of endocrinology internationally.

EDUCATION

  • Zaporizhzhia State Medical Institute, Ukraine
  • Specialisation in endocrinology and internal medicine at the Institute of Endocrinology, Metabolism and Hypertension, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Fellowship at the Ichilov medical centre, Tel Aviv, Israel
  • Specialisation in internal medicine at the Meir medical centre, Kfar Saba, Israel

LANGUAGES

  • Hebrew
  • English
  • Russian

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Endocrine Society
  • Israel Diabetes Association
  • Israel association for the treatment of obesity

Dr Igor Kazansky: leading orthopaedic and trauma surgeon, specialist in joint replacement

Professional overview:
A highly qualified orthopaedic and trauma surgeon, Dr Igor Kazansky specialises in hip and knee replacement. He holds the post of senior orthopaedic surgeon at Assuta, the largest clinic in Tel Aviv.

Main specialisations:

  • Shoulder injuries
  • Shoulder joint surgery
  • Elbow joint surgery
  • Shoulder and elbow replacement
  • Joint arthroscopy
  • Repair of the tendons of the shoulder
  • Repair of the tendons of the elbow
  • Restoring shoulder stability in subluxation
  • Surgical restoration of range of movement in frozen shoulder
  • Treatment of sports injuries

Education:

  • Medical institute in Vitebsk, Belarus.
  • Postgraduate study at Tel Aviv University, Israel.
  • Fellowship at the Assaf Harofeh clinic, Be'er Ya'akov, Israel.
  • Specialisation in surgical orthopaedics and trauma, Wolfson hospital, Holon, Israel.
  • Specialisation in joint replacement, Klinik hospital, Minden, Germany; clinics in Bayreuth, Berlin and Strasbourg.

Languages:

  • Russian
  • English
  • Hebrew
  • German

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Association of Orthopaedic Surgeons
  • Israel Society for Hip and Knee Surgery
  • International Society of Arthroscopy, Knee Surgery and Orthopaedic Sports Medicine (ISAKOS)

Dr Kazansky is known for his professionalism and deep knowledge of orthopaedic surgery, performing some 300 successful operations each year.
